name: openfolk
description: Messenger-style web app for running AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ACP) on your own machines

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w local && npm run typecheck -w relay && tsc -p webapp
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.lint: oxlint webapp/js webapp/i18n local/src relay/src shared tests/browser mobile/scripts
scripts.test: npm run test -w local && npm run test -w relay && npm run test:browser
